public_rationale: A December 2025 Project Vend account explicitly describes an AI shopkeeper sourcing items and executing sales. On the ordinary application-level reading, that is a story about operating a business, beyond the three content tasks listed. The experiment's failures do not remove the counterexample to 'every story'. This finding does not establish that the agent was reliable, economical or fully autonomous.
limitations: The classification depends on the meaning of 'generating something'; a reading encompassing all tool commands would change the result.
Project Vend was a company-run experiment with human assistance.
The cited story is a primary company report, not an independent audit.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Every AI agent story is about code generation, summarization, or generating content from an information source of uncertain trustworthiness.

statement.excerpt: Every “AI agent” story is either about code generation, summarizing some sort of information source, or generating something based on an information source that you may or may not be able to trust.
statement.document_title: I Will Never Respect A Website

from_speaker: summarizing some sort of information source
generating something based on an information source
our_interpretation: I read 'story' as a published account of an AI-agent application, including a research case study.
The ordinary application-level reading distinguishes generating content from using tools to execute transactions or operate a business.
Interpreting 'generating something' to include every internal command would make the assertion effectively unfalsifiable; that broader reading remains a material ambiguity.
The target is the body of published stories available by 2026-04-14. The speaker supplies no lower date.
criteria.support_condition: A sufficiently comprehensive account of the relevant published stories showing that their applications fall entirely within the three named categories.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one pre-publication AI-agent story describing an application outside those categories, such as executing sales or changing an external system's state.

evidence.explanation: This published AI-agent story describes operating a shop and executing sales, an application beyond content generation on the stated reading. The event date is the story's publication, because the claim concerns which stories existed.
